{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Confirm the conversion
print(sales['revenue_clean'].dtype)
print(sales['revenue_clean'].head())

# Check for QA orders — they have revenue 999999.99
qa_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()
print(f'Number of QA orders: {qa_count}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = sales['status'] == 'refunded'
refunded_count = refunded_mask.sum()
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}')

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_only = sales[~refunded_mask]
print(f'After filtering completed orders: {len(completed_only)} rows')

# Remove QA orders
clean_data = completed_only[~qa_mask]
print(f'After removing QA orders: {len(clean_data)} rows')

# Check unique channels in clean_data
channels_clean = clean_data['channel'].unique()
print(f'Unique channels after filtering: {channels_clean}')"}
